youtube_short.title: The Salary Secret Your Boss Won't Tell You
title_alternatives: Why 60% of Workers Are Underpaid Right Now
Ask This One Question to Earn $14K More
youtube_short.description: Your company has a salary band for every single position — a floor, a midpoint, and a ceiling. Research shows 60% of workers are paid below the midpoint, and most never even think to ask. In states that require pay range transparency, workers earn $14,000 more per year on average. Before your next performance review, ask HR one question: 'What's the salary band for my role?' It's legal, it's expected, and it's the most profitable question you'll ask all year. Follow for more hidden money moves. #personalfinance #salary #moneytips #careertips

hook_line: Your boss is hiding a number that could change your life
